antiSlopProtocol.description: Explicit bans and requirements to preserve cultural safety, legibility, and non-tokenistic representation.
banned: Crown or monarchy symbols - any form, any opacity
Passports, visas, ID cards, border gates, government forms, bureaucratic aesthetics
Aboriginal art imitation - dot painting, invented Aboriginal-style patterns, sacred motif appropriation
Using Aboriginal flag colors as general decoration - allowed only in situ on placards or posters
Symmetrical geometric layouts as the dominant structure
Static single-weight fonts minus non-variable font usage
Overuse of slogans across screens or tiles - slogan wallpaper
Mixing devotional Shiva and First Nations solidarity into a single composite motif
Hardcoded border-radius px values in component code - use sys-radius-star or sys-shape-star tokens
Uniform 4-corner radius - border-radius 8px all corners - the Institutional Squelch
shape.blob star tokens outside Substrate archetype without explicit whitelist exception
Scaffold archetype elements that morph on interaction - Scaffold is immutable
Old deprecated archetype names in code or docs - Seed, Pebble, Lens, Jar, Cabinet - use Strike/March/Megaphone/Placard/Scaffold/Substrate
required: Dark-only Solidarity mode on charcoal base
Variable fonts with wght 100-900, wdth 75-125, opsz 8-144
Extreme variable contrast - enforce 9x weight ratio (100 vs 900) and 6x size ratio (12px vs 72px plus)
M3 Expressive motion curve for typographic transitions - cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)
Icon-scale motifs must be recognizable at 24px
Wheat-paste or brick or paint textures remain background-only - foreground UI retains legibility
First Nations solidarity appears only in situ via placards or posters or acknowledgment text
